mechanism: Codeine is metabolized by CYP2D6 to morphine and other active metabolites; phenelzine (MAOI) combined with codeine increases serotonergic activity and CNS depression, creating risk for serotonin syndrome and respiratory depression.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, use alternative opioid with minimal serotonergic activity and reduce codeine dose significantly with close monitoring for serotonin syndrome and respiratory depression.
